summary: This Form 6-K filing by UBS Group AG provides a periodic disclosure of the company's consolidated capital instruments and TLAC-eligible senior unsecured debt as of March 31, 2026. It is a routine regulatory report under the Swiss SRB framework, listing outstanding AT1 and Tier 2 instruments with their terms and recognition amounts. There is no transaction event, no acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring announced. The filing is purely informational and does not represent a special situation.
